[[File:Bas-relief_sculpture.png|thumb|right|200px|Gomalo's bas&ndash;relief sculpture]]
{{Quote|Really, the sculpture was not an outstanding piece.|Cham and Nog Teleus on Gomalo's bas-relief sculpture|<ref name="WhatIsThatTynnanDoing">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian}}</ref>}}
A '''bas&ndash;relief sculpture''' was a type of sculpture. One such example was crafted by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Gomalo]]; it depicted a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]], a [[Tarasin]], a Rodian, and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], all of whom wore the logo of the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang dubbed the [[Dark Star Hellions/Legends|Dark Star Hellions]]. The art did not depict real individuals, but was in fact a coded map referring to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]&mdash;[[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] respectively.  A fifth star marked the location of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in which Gomalo had secreted the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]&ndash;frozen body of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ji-Ad Sarain]]. The sculpture subsequently came into the possession of Tynnan industrialists [[Cham Teleus|Cham]] and [[Nog Teleus]]; however, it was stolen. Cham and Nog kept a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] image of the piece as insurance, despite the fact that they did not consider it particularly worthy. Following the rescue of Sarain, Cham and Nog awarded his rescuers miniature [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]&ndash;sized copies of the sculpture, along with two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each for returning most of their art collection.<ref name="WhatIsThatTynnanDoing" />
